name: Roasted Carrot Salad with Lentils, Arugula, Pumpkin Seeds & Mint
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).

Using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt, cover, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces. Transfer to the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle with spices. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast carrots, stirring halfway through, until golden brown and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the carrots are roasting, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice shallot into half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl and stir to combine.
When the lentils are done, drain in a colander, rinse with cold water, and add to the bowl.
Just before serving, add roasted carrots, arugula, and pumpkin seeds to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
